neighbours.label: 'so' + degree that sets up a result: 'So extensive was the damage that', 'so much that', 'So angry,', French 'tellement'; connective 'so' stays quiet
fire: So great was the crowd that the doors were shut.
So bitter was the dispute that the club split in two.
The praise lifts her confidence so much that she tries again.
She was furious. So furious, she walked out of court.
So heavy was the snow that the roof gave way.
He loved the town so much that he never left.
So rapid was the rise that nobody noticed.
quiet: So we locked the doors and walked to the bus.
It was bitter out, so the club stayed in.
The praise came late, so she tried again.
She was furious and walked out of court.
So far the snow has not reached the roof.
He loved the town and never left.
So I told him that nobody noticed.

short: so + degree, about to give a result
